description.en: Venezuela, officially the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, is a sovereign country situated along the northern coast of South America. Bordered by the Caribbean Sea to the north, Colombia to the west, Brazil to the south, and Guyana to the east, Venezuela possesses the largest proven oil reserves in the world. Historically one of the wealthiest countries in Latin America, the nation has attracted significant international attention in recent years due to severe political instability, hyperinflation, and a major socioeconomic crisis.
description.zh: Venezuela（委內瑞拉，全稱為委內瑞拉玻利瓦共和國）是位於南美洲北部的多元主權國家。其北臨廣闊的加勒比海，西接哥倫比亞（Colombia），南鄰巴西（Brazil），東接蓋亞那（Guyana）。委內瑞拉國境內蘊藏著全球規模最大的已探明石油儲量，在歷史上曾是拉丁美洲人均最富裕、現代化程度最高的國家之一。然而，近年來由於國內政局長期動盪、惡性通貨膨脹以及嚴峻的社會經濟危機，使這座石油巨擘成為國際地緣政治與經濟轉型外交的高度關注焦點。

seoText.en: Read quick facts about Venezuela — population, land area, capital city, and short overview. Discover Caracas administrative center, Maracaibo oil fields, Angel Falls tallest waterfall, Caribbean coastlines, and socioeconomic crisis.
seoText.zh: 快速了解委內瑞拉的基本資料：人口、面積、首都與簡短概述。探索卡拉卡斯行政中心、馬拉開波石油重鎮、安赫爾天使瀑布、加勒比海沿岸風光，以及近年面臨的經濟轉型挑戰。

list: Sovereign republic resting along the northern coast of South America
Holds the largest proven petroleum oil reserves in the entire world
Renowned for housing Angel Falls, the world's tallest uninterrupted waterfall
Currently addressing severe domestic economic inflation and political crisis
en.text:
Composed of beautiful Caribbean islands, snow-capped Andean peaks, and the vast tropical forests of the Guiana Highlands, Venezuela displays a highly varied geography. Home to over 28 million residents, its society possesses a deep mixed heritage of Spanish, indigenous, and African cultures. Spanish is the official language, spoken with a warm, rhythmic coastal Caribbean tone.

From the busy, mountain-shadowed valleys of Caracas to the heavy oil rigs of Lake Maracaibo, Venezuela stands as a historically wealthy but currently challenged nation in South America.

list: 位於南美洲北部的石油國家
擁有全球最大石油儲量之一
加勒比海沿岸重要國家
近年面臨嚴重經濟與政治危機
zh.text: 國土北緣延伸出蔚藍的加勒比海島鏈，西北部聳立著白雪皚皚的安地斯山脈，南部則隱沒於蓋亞那高地（Guiana Highlands）與亞馬遜的原始熱帶雨林中，委內瑞拉（Venezuela）展現出令人讚嘆的多元地理風貌。這片土地孕育了約 2,000 萬名留守居民，社會文化在歷史洪流中揉合了西班牙殖民者、美洲原住民以及非洲黑奴的深厚文化根源。西班牙語為官方語言，語調帶有加勒比海沿岸特有的溫暖、輕快與強烈節奏感。從首都卡拉卡斯（Caracas）群山環抱、車水馬龍的高原谷地，到馬拉開波湖（Lake Maracaibo）上日夜轟鳴的重型石油鑽井平台，委內瑞拉歷史上曾是一座無比富裕的資源帝國，如今正處於充滿挑戰的國家重建轉折期。

list: Beautiful Caribbean coastlines and islands span the northern border
Andean mountain ridges extend into the northwestern states
Southern region contains the ancient plateaus of the Guiana Highlands
Home to Angel Falls, plummeting 979 meters through tropical jungle cliffs
en.text:
Covering approximately 916,445 square kilometers, Venezuela features a highly diverse topography. It is split into the northern coastal Andes region, the flat central grasslands of the Llanos, and the wild southern Amazonian forests.

The Guiana Highlands in the southeast contain the spectacular flat-topped table mountains (tepuis), over which Angel Falls cascades as the highest waterfall on Earth.

list: 擁有加勒比海海岸線
地形包含山地、高原與雨林
南部為亞馬遜與圭亞那高地地區
擁有世界最高瀑布
zh.text: 委內瑞拉（Venezuela）國土面積約 91 萬 6,445 平方公里，地形地貌複雜多樣。大致可分化為四大地理區：西北部挺拔的安地斯高山沿海區、中部一望無際的奧里諾科（Llanos）熱帶大草原、西部肥沃的馬拉開波低地盆地，以及南部原始狂野的亞馬遜雨林。位於東南部的蓋亞那高地（Guiana Highlands）蘊藏著地球上最古老的平頂桌山地形（Tepuis），舉世聞名的安赫爾瀑布（Angel Falls，又稱天使瀑布）便是從高達 979 公尺的垂直峭壁懸崖上呼嘯而下，激盪出地表上落差最高的自然奇觀。

list: Predominantly tropical climate with seasonal dry and rainy periods
Lowland plains and Caribbean beaches remain hot and humid year-round
Mountain regions and high plateaus offer mild, cool temperatures
Heavy rainfall occurs between May and November, feeding major rivers
en.text:
Venezuela's climate is tropical but strongly influenced by altitude. The coastal ports and plains of the Llanos experience high temperatures, while the cities in the Andes valleys, such as Caracas, enjoy a spring-like climate.

The country has a clear rainy season from May to November, which supplies water to the massive Orinoco River system.

list: 熱帶氣候為主
全年氣溫偏高
高海拔地區較涼爽
雨季與乾季分明
zh.text: 委內瑞拉全境普遍屬於熱帶氣候，但地方氣候特徵強烈受到地形海拔高度的垂直調節。低平的沿海港口與中部大草原（Llanos）全年高溫潮濕、陽光熾熱；然而，座落於安地斯山脈谷地中的都市圈（如首都卡拉卡斯）則因海拔適中，終年享受著如微風徐徐、四季如春的怡人高原氣候。該國擁有界線分明的乾濕兩季，每年 5 月至 11 月的強烈雨季源源不斷地為龐大的奧里諾科（Orinoco）河流域與水力發電廠注入豐沛水源。

list: Population of approximately 28 million citizens residing in the country
Highly urbanized, with the majority concentrated in northern cities
Rich ethnic blend of Spanish colonial roots and indigenous heritages
Recent economic challenges have led to significant international emigration
en.text:
Venezuela has a population of around 28 million, predominantly concentrated in northern mountain valleys and coastal hubs. The population is mostly Mestizo, reflecting a blend of European, indigenous, and African roots.

Due to severe economic inflation and political crisis over the last decade, over 7 million Venezuelans have emigrated, creating large diaspora communities across Latin America and North America.

list: 人口約 2800萬左右
人口集中於北部城市
城市化程度高
大量人口外移
zh.text: 委內瑞拉目前國內常住人口約為 2,800 萬人，人口高度集中在北部的安地斯山谷與加勒比海沿岸都会圈。在族群與人口結構上，委內瑞拉展現出高度的混血特質：**印歐混血的梅斯蒂索人（Mestizos）高佔總人口的 51.6%（約 1,444 萬人）**；**歐洲裔白人（主要為西班牙裔，以及二戰後移入的義大利、德、葡移民後裔）佔 43.6%（約 1,220 萬人）**，這兩個群體構成了大都會區的社會與經貿主力；此外，**非裔委內瑞拉人約佔 3.6%（約 100 萬人）**，美洲印第安原住民（如 Wayuu 族）則約佔 1.1%。然而，過去十年間因惡性通膨與政經崩潰，引發了南美歷史上最龐大的外流移民潮，已有超過 700 萬委內瑞拉人跨越邊境，在拉丁美洲各國與北美形成龐大的海外離散社群。

list: Economy remains heavily dependent on crude petroleum oil exports
Possesses immense proven oil fields, centered in Lake Maracaibo
Currently addressing severe currency inflation and budget crises
Experiencing decline in manufacturing, agriculture, and utility systems
en.text:
Venezuela's economy is highly dependent on oil, which accounts for over 90% of national export revenues. The country contains massive heavy oil fields in the Orinoco Belt and Lake Maracaibo.

However, decline in infrastructure, economic mismanagement, and international sanctions have led to a severe collapse in oil production, causing hyperinflation and food shortages.

list: 高度依賴石油產業
曾為南美富裕國家之一
通膨與貨幣危機嚴重
基礎產業衰退明顯
zh.text: 委內瑞拉經濟是一具典型高度單一化的「石油引擎」，原油出口產值高佔國家總出口外匯的 90% 以上。其馬拉開波湖盆地與奧里諾科重油帶蘊藏著震驚世界的黑金財富。然而，近年來由於基礎設施維護不當、外匯管理失衡以及嚴厲的國際貿易制裁重擊，導致原油產量出現歷史性下滑，進而引發惡性通貨膨脹、本國貨幣（Bolívar）劇烈貶值與嚴重的民生物資與醫藥短缺，使得傳統製造業與精緻農業面臨嚴峻的重組轉型與重啟挑戰。

list: Federal presidential republic characterized by long-term executive dominance
President serves as both head of state and head of government
Vibrant political division between the ruling party and the opposition
Ongoing discussions surrounding international recognition and elections
en.text:
Venezuela is a presidential republic. Over the last two decades, the political landscape has been highly polarized, with intense struggles between the United Socialist Party (PSUV) government and the opposition alliance.

Electoral disputes, human rights discussions, and rival legislative bodies have created a complex political standoff that remains a major focus of international diplomacy.

list: 共和制國家
政治局局勢長期動盪
政府與反對派對立嚴重
國際承認問題曾引發爭議
zh.text: 委內瑞拉（Venezuela）政治體制名義上為聯邦總統共和制。但在過去二十多年的實務運作中，呈現出行政權高度集中的查維茲主義（Chavismo）色彩。國內政治版圖極度兩極化，由執政的統一社會主義黨（PSUV）政府與實力不俗的反對派政治聯盟展開長年拉鋸與體制對抗。圍繞著大選合法性、人權保護範疇、外資財產權產權保障以及多個平行立法機關的權限爭議，形塑了極其複雜的政治僵局，至今仍是美國、歐盟與拉美地緣外交斡旋與制裁談判的核心風暴眼。

list: Daily life shaped by high inflation and shortages of basic goods
Decline in public hospitals, clean water, and power grid stability
Vibrant community solidarity and mutual aid systems in local towns
Mass emigration has transformed family structures across the nation
en.text:
Venezuelan society has faced massive challenges due to the collapse of public services, healthcare, and schools. Daily life requires resilience, with families relying on money sent from relatives abroad.

Despite these hardships, community organizations, soup kitchens, and local neighborhood networks work hard to support vulnerable children and elderly residents.

list: 生活成本與通膨問題嚴重
公共服務品質下降
貧困問題擴大
移民與家庭分離現象明顯
zh.text: 委內瑞拉社會目前正展現出超乎想像的民間抗壓韌性。儘管國家公共電力、自來水供應網與公立醫院體系因長年財政危機而出現服務品質下滑，多數家庭日常高度仰賴海外親屬匯回的外匯（Remittances）苦撐度日。但在基層社會中，強大的人道互助網絡、社區廚房與非政府地方自治組織依然高度活躍，自發性地照顧著無數因大規模移民潮而留守本土的「孤老與留守兒童」，展現出拉丁美洲社會深厚的家族牽絆與互助溫情。

list: Deep Caribbean culture featuring joropo folk music and salsa beats
Baseball ranks as the absolute favorite sport of the nation
Famous for 'El Sistema', a world-class youth orchestra program
Delicious staple foods led by cornmeal 'arepas' and 'pabellón'
en.text:
Venezuela possesses a rich and colorful cultural heritage. In music, 'El Sistema' is a world-famous, state-funded music education program that has trained thousands of youth from poor neighborhoods.

In sports, baseball is the national passion, producing legendary MLB stars like Miguel Cabrera. The national food is the 'Arepa' (flat cornmeal pocket filled with cheese or meat).

list: 拉丁美洲文化色彩濃厚
音樂與舞蹈文化活躍
棒球運動極受歡迎
加勒比海文化影響深厚
zh.text: 委內瑞拉的文化血統完美調和了熱情的加勒比海風情。在音樂藝術領域，該國開創了震驚古典樂壇的「國立青少年管弦樂團系統（El Sistema）」，該免費公共音樂教育計畫成功將無數出身貧民窟的街頭弱勢孩童推向世界最高藝術殿堂（如國際傳奇指揮大師古斯塔沃·杜達美）；在體育文化上，與多數熱愛足球的南美國家截然不同，棒球是委內瑞拉無可匹敵的獨尊國球，長年源源不絕地向美國職棒大聯盟（MLB）輸出頂級全明星球星；在飲食上，由優質玉米粉烘烤、包裹著起司與多汁碎肉的國民美食「阿瑞巴（Arepa）餅」，則是全民跨階級的共同靈魂美食。

list: Stabilizing the national currency and reducing extreme inflation
Resolving the political standoff to rebuild democratic institutions
Restoring basic utilities like electricity, water, and hospitals
Managing the social impact of millions of emigrated citizens
en.text:
Venezuela's primary challenge is rebuilding its broken economy, controlling inflation, and restoring stable electricity and water systems. 

Finding a peaceful political resolution is essential to remove international trade sanctions, restore oil output, and encourage the return of millions of skilled citizens living abroad.

list: 惡性通貨膨脹
政治與社會危機
大量人口外移
石油產業衰退與制裁問題
zh.text: 委內瑞拉當前重中之重的核心考驗，在於全面遏止本國貨幣惡性貶值、健全中央財政以重建外資信心，並撥款重修脆弱不堪的國家電網與醫院水利系統。尋求跨黨派的政治大和解，是該國解除國際貿易與金融 sanctions 制裁、吸引數百萬流落海外的高階知識份子與工程師回流，並促使「石油產業與產量重回黃金巔峰」不可或缺的全面停損關鍵。

list: Caracas — Mountain-sheltered capital and metropolitan center
Angel Falls — Breathtaking waterfall deep in Canaima National Park
Maracaibo — Historical city situated next to the massive oil lake
Los Roques — Beautiful Caribbean archipelago and coral reef sanctuary
en.text:
Angel Falls (Kerepakupai Merú) is the ultimate natural symbol of Venezuela, falling through the ancient forests of Canaima National Park. Caracas sits in a valley under the green Avila mountain range.

Lake Maracaibo is a massive brackish bay connected to the sea, famous for its offshore oil fields and spectacular Catatumbo lightning storms.

list: 卡拉卡斯（Caracas）—首都與最大城市
馬拉開波（Maracaibo）——石油重鎮與大湖
安赫爾瀑布（Angel Falls）——世界最高瀑布與自然景觀
羅克斯群島（Los Roques）——加勒比海珊瑚礁群島
zh.text: 舉世聞名的安赫爾瀑布（Angel Falls，委內瑞拉原住民語：Kerepakupai Merú）是該國至高無上的頂級自然圖騰，深藏於卡奈馬國家公園（Canaima National Park）萬年原始叢林與桌山絕壁中；首都卡拉卡斯（Caracas）則是一座座落於綠意盎然、雲霧繚繞的阿維拉山谷（Ávila Valley）之中的高原熱帶大都會；歷史石油重鎮馬拉開波（Maracaibo）緊鄰廣闊無垠、連接海洋的馬拉開波湖盆地，除了星羅棋布的湖面原油鑽探基地外，其出水口更因獨特微氣候常年上演著震撼世界的「卡塔圖博閃電（Catatumbo Lightning）」不滅自然奇觀；北方的羅克斯群島（Los Roques）則以如萬花筒般的珊瑚礁群與奶油細沙灘，名列加勒比海最頂級的海洋生態保護區。

list: Founding member of OPEC, historically leading oil diplomacy
Tense relations with the United States and European nations
Close economic and political alliances with Russia, China, and Cuba
Regional diplomacy is complex due to refugee outflows
en.text:
Venezuela was a founding member of OPEC, historically wielding significant influence in global oil markets. However, political shifts have led to tense relations with the US and Europe.

It maintains close economic, military, and financial ties with China, Russia, and Iran, while its relations with South American neighbors remain complex due to border security and refugee flows.

list: 石油外交歷史悠久
與美國關係緊張
與部分拉美與亞洲國家合作密切
政治立場具爭議性
zh.text: 委內瑞拉（Venezuela）是石油輸出國組織（OPEC）赫赫有名的創始成員國，歷史上在全球能源外交與油價制定中具備呼風喚雨的戰略發言權。冷戰後由於政治意識形態劇烈左轉，使其與美國（United States）及多個歐盟國家維持著長期的冰凍僵持與外交制裁對抗。地緣政治上，委內瑞拉與中國、俄羅斯、伊朗及古巴建立了極為深厚的經濟融資、軍事設備與能源開採全方位戰略同盟；而由於數百萬難民外流帶來的跨國邊境安全與安置問題，使其與哥倫比亞、秘魯等南美洲鄰國的外交關係，始終交織著複雜的博弈與對話局勢。

list: Trade exchanges are limited, focused on basic goods
Bilateral interactions managed through representative offices in nearby nations
Small-scale imports of Venezuelan cacao beans and raw materials
Occasional academic and humanitarian assistance program activities
en.text:
Taiwan and Venezuela share very limited non-official trade relations. Venezuelan exports include minor quantities of petrochemicals and high-quality cacao beans to Taiwan, which in turn exports basic machinery and auto parts.

Bilateral contact is managed through representative offices in Colombia and the US, with occasional support from Taiwanese NGOs during social crises.

list: 無正式外交關係
經貿往來有限
民間交流較少
非官方互動為主
zh.text: 委內瑞拉與台灣之間目前並無正式官方外交關係，雙邊互動保持低調、穩健的非官方實質商務往來。台灣主要向委內瑞拉採購少量精緻化學工業原料，以及烘焙業界極其推崇、風味濃郁的頂級委內瑞拉精選可可豆（Cacao Beans）；台灣則向其出口基礎工業機具、機車零組件與精密電子零組件。雙邊的領事事務與投資考察，主要透過台灣「駐哥倫比亞台北商務辦事處」及駐美相關機構跨國兼轄代管。在近年委內瑞拉面臨嚴峻民生考驗期間，台灣的多家國際非政府組織（NGO）亦曾多次攜手國際夥伴，對其本土弱勢社群提供零星的醫療物資與人道援助關懷。

list: Possesses the absolute largest proven oil reserves on the planet
Angel Falls stands as the tallest uninterrupted waterfall in the world
A major global cradle for legendary Major League Baseball players
Navigating one of South America's most severe socioeconomic crises
擁有全球最大石油儲量之一
天使瀑布為世界最高瀑布
曾為拉丁美洲高收入國家
近年出現大規模移民潮

text.en: The Bolivar Flag — The yellow, blue, and red flag featuring the arc of eight white stars representing the provinces of independence
text.zh: 玻利瓦三色八星旗——黃色象徵國家的黃金與財富，藍色象徵加勒比海，紅色象徵爭取獨立的鮮血，中央呈半圓形排列的八顆白星，代表歷史上的獨立省分（Provinces）

text.en: Angel Falls (Kerepakupai Merú) — Plummeting from a high flat-topped tepui mountain, the highest waterfall in the world
text.zh: 天使瀑布安赫爾瀑布——位於蓋亞那高地（Guiana Highlands）深處的桌山之上，落差高達979公尺，水流在落地前便化為一片飄渺雲霧，被公認為地球上最神秘壯麗的自然奇觀之一

text.en: Global Oil Giant — Holding immense proven petroleum reservoirs, heavily shaping the national economic history
text.zh: 全球最大已探明石油儲量——奧里諾科重油帶與馬拉開波湖蘊藏了龐大的原油儲量，儲量高居全球首位，石油產業一度使委內瑞拉成為拉丁美洲人均最富裕的現代化國家

text.en: Baseball Passion — Producing world-class MLB superstars, serving as the most popular national sport
text.zh: 棒球狂熱的搖籃——與多數南美國家熱愛足球不同，棒球是委內瑞拉最瘋狂的國民運動，並源源不絕地為美國職棒大聯盟（MLB）輸送了數百名頂級球星與名人堂傳奇

text.en: El Sistema — The globally celebrated music education network, transforming poverty-stricken youth into elite classical musicians
text.zh: 改變命運的音樂系統 El Sistema——委內瑞拉開創的世界級青少年管弦樂團培育計畫，為貧民窟的弱勢兒童提供免費樂器與音樂訓練，孕育出包括杜達美（Gustavo Dudamel）在內的無數頂尖指揮家與音樂大師
